obligations.statement: The mechanism must be enclosed within a housing such that all moving parts are contained.
derivation_premises: If any mechanism part protrudes, the housing does not fully enclose it.
If the housing is absent, the mechanism is not enclosed.

obligations.statement: A user must be able to reach and operate an external hand crank.
derivation_premises: If the crank is unreachable, the user cannot rotate it.
If the crank is not operable, the user cannot raise/lower the platform.

obligations.statement: The platform must be able to travel a vertical distance between 80 mm and 100 mm.
derivation_premises: If the travel range is not achievable, the requirement is not met.

obligations.statement: The platform must support a payload of approximately 1 kg without failure.
derivation_premises: If the structure cannot bear the load, it will deform or break.

obligations.statement: The mechanism must be safe to use, with no hazards such as sharp edges, pinch points, or unintended motion.
derivation_premises: If there are pinch points or exposed sharp edges, the user may be injured.

obligations.statement: The mechanism must be mechanically plausible, meaning the proposed mechanism can be physically realized and function as intended.
derivation_premises: If the mechanism violates kinematic constraints, it cannot operate.

obligations.statement: The product must be easy to assemble, meaning it can be assembled without excessive effort or specialized tools.
derivation_premises: If assembly requires difficult access or complex operations, it is not easy.

obligations.statement: The product must be practical to manufacture, meaning the design can be produced with reasonable cost and feasibility.
derivation_premises: If the design requires exotic or expensive processes, it is not practical.

obligations.statement: The mechanism must not jam during operation and must operate stably.
derivation_premises: If components bind or interfere, the mechanism will jam.

obligations.statement: The mechanism must have a clear motion path for the platform to travel 80-100 mm without internal collision.
derivation_premises: If the platform collides with housing or other parts, it cannot reach the required travel.

obligations.statement: The hand crank must be reachable and operable from outside the housing.
derivation_premises: If the crank is hidden inside, the user cannot access it.

obligations.statement: The mechanism must be retained within the housing during operation and assembly.
derivation_premises: If parts can escape, the mechanism is not enclosed.

obligations.statement: The mechanism must provide a reaction path for the payload weight to the housing or base.
derivation_premises: If the load is not reacted, the platform will accelerate downward.

obligations.statement: The mechanism must provide a reaction path for the user-applied torque on the crank.
derivation_premises: If the torque is not reacted, the crank will spin freely and not drive the mechanism.

obligations.statement: The platform must remain substantially horizontal during operation to support the payload.
derivation_premises: If the platform tilts, the payload may slide off.

obligations.statement: The mechanism must be able to hold the platform at a desired position without continuous input (self-locking or sufficient friction).
derivation_premises: If the mechanism back-drives, the platform will lower unexpectedly.

obligations.statement: The hand crank must be accessible for assembly and operation without requiring disassembly of the housing.
derivation_premises: If the crank is buried inside, it cannot be operated or assembled.

candidates.summary: Scissor lift with lead screw drive and external hand crank.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Scissor linkage provides required mobility; screw drive may require additional supports.

candidates.summary: Lead screw and nut linear actuator with external hand crank.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Screw provides linear motion; may need guide to prevent rotation.

candidates.summary: Rack and pinion with external hand crank and internal guides.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Rack and pinion may require a brake or locking mechanism to prevent back-drive.

candidates.summary: Scissor lift with hydraulic or pneumatic actuation (not manual).

evidence_route_verdict.note: Scissor lift is feasible, but not manually operated as required.

unresolved.decision: The ambiguity regarding 'approximately' travel and payload needs to be clarified to determine if the travel range is a strict band or a loose requirement, and if the payload is a hard limit.
unresolved.why_open: AMB-0001 affects OBL-0003 and OBL-0004, which are critical for candidate selection.

unresolved.decision: Whether the external hand crank is considered part of the mechanism and must be enclosed or can remain external affects OBL-0011 and OBL-0001.
unresolved.why_open: AMB-0002 remains unresolved, impacting whether the crank must be housed or can be external.

unresolved.decision: Detail design choices (materials, geometry) need to be made to verify load capacity and manufacturing feasibility, but these are currently free (FRE-0002, FRE-0003).
unresolved.why_open: The load capacity and manufacturing practicality cannot be confirmed until material and detail design are chosen.

assumptions.statement: The hand crank is external to the housing but is part of the product and can be manually operated by the user.
assumptions.why: The text states 'external hand crank' and 'mechanism enclosed', implying the crank is outside the housing.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If it is specified that the hand crank is also enclosed or retractable.

assumptions.statement: The platform 'raises and lowers' implies vertical motion.
assumptions.why: The travel range is given in mm, and common platform lifters move vertically.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the platform is specified to move horizontally or in another orientation.
